verdict: A close, well-structured rebuild of the Explore feed whose biggest gap is the icon set (Material/Lucide glyphs instead of SF Symbols in the top bar and tab bar) and a fallback font with uneven tracking, while the flex layout and templated rows make it very editable.

top_defects.where: top bar actions pill and tab bar
top_defects.what: Lucide rounded 'copy' and outlined Material 'account_circle' instead of the square tabs icon and filled-person circle; Material home/bookmark/clock glyphs (rounded house, short bookmark, thick clock hands) instead of the SF Symbols house.fill, bookmark.fill, clock.fill; calendar_month outline instead of the filled-header calendar in 'Which came first?'
SF Pro not resolved: a fallback face with wider, uneven tracking ('Activit y', 'Nixon à', 'Footballeur français' noticeably wider) and heavier tab labels (semibold-looking vs regular 12 pt)
opaque white/90 glass with no content visible through it, where the reference shows the second Top read row blurred through the Liquid Glass bar; selected 'Home' is #3366cc instead of #2975bf
battery and Wi-Fi glyphs smaller than the reference (battery ~28x13 pt vs ~30x14 pt with bolder '39'), bell-slash a filled Material glyph

top_defects.where: Top read card and section headers
top_defects.what: rows and headers drift 2-4 px (Pablo Pagis title ~2 px high, second row title ~2 px high, Games header 1-2 px low); feed bottom cells meanDiff up to 17.5

top_defects.where: Top read row 2 behind the tab bar
top_defects.what: the row's description ('Article de liste de Wikipédia') that shows through the tab bar in the reference is not visible

top_defects.where: Games / Top read section headers and cards
top_defects.what: the two section headers and two card shells are copy-pasted rather than one template; 156 arbitrary values (e.g. text-[15px], #72777d, #3366cc repeated) instead of shared tokens
dots recoloured with a CSS filter chain (invert/sepia/hue-rotate) on an image instead of a coloured vector; status bar signal/battery hand-built from divs

strengths: All feed content present and exact, including accents, the 'Card hidden · Undo' banner and the faded Star Academy row under the tab bar
Event rows, Top read rows and tab items are templates driven by data, inside flex columns that reflow
Measured palette used correctly: #202122 text, #72777d secondary, #3366cc links, #f8f9fa-like banner
